Green Cloud Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, January 4, 2010 - 12:38am

Ingredients




1 pkg. lime Jello
1 cup boiling water
1 cup cold water
1 cup tiny marshmallows
1 cup cottage cheese
1 pkg. Dream Whip
1 cup pecans
1/2 cup pineapple juice
1 cup crushed pineapple

Preparation

1 Dissolve Jello with boiling water. Add marshmallows. Stir to melt, then add cold water and pineapple juice. Chill until set. Whip the Dream Whip according to the directions on the package. Add to cottage cheese and crushed pineapple. Fold in Dream Whip and chill.
